name: Golden Wings
text:
This pair of huge wings is crafted from numerous feathers made of a lightweight, golden magical alloy. When activated, the wings emit a melodic sound and a shimmering glow.

---
Activate—Assisted Flight 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, you can leap 20 feet, using the wings to propel yourself. You must land on a space with solid ground. For the duration, you also emit a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. You take a –2 item penalty to Stealth checks to hide and sneak.

Effect: Assisted Flight
